I saved this as a project rule in the EngramDB memory store, so it will come up in future sessions: all background jobs go through `jobs.enqueue()`, and Celery is never called directly (no `.delay()`, `apply_async()` or `send_task()`).

Right now the repo has no `jobs.enqueue` and no Celery code at all. So `jobs.enqueue()` will need to be written before anything can use it. I put that in the memory too.
